observation: Inspected front, top and isometric views once. The neutral mechanism proof shows two separate front thumb bats with covered pivot roots, a right-side plunger, and a narrow ramp aligned to the open bucket. The flag panel is visibly connected through one rigid arm and hub to that bucket. The marble sits within the bucket; both axle caps and four accessible frame mounting heads are present. No misplaced, floating or visibly intersecting proof component found. This is placement evidence for the early mechanism blockout; full field, return and containment construction remains pending.
